sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
The core gameplay mechanics of Jumpy Noob are simple yet challenging. The player controls a character who must jump over cactuses that are moving horizontally across the screen. The game starts off slow, but as you progress through the levels, the speed and difficulty increase. The player must time their jumps perfectly to avoid hitting the cactuses. One wrong move, and the game is over.
      
      The gameplay is divided into different levels, each with its own set of challenges and obstacles. The levels get progressively harder, introducing new types of cactuses and obstacles that the player must avoid. The game also features a leaderboards system, where players can compete with each other to achieve the highest score.
      
      The controls are responsive and easy to use, making it simple for players to navigate the game's world. The game also features different control schemes, allowing players to choose the one that suits them best. Whether you prefer to play with a mouse, keyboard, or touch controls, Jumpy Noob has got you covered.
